generated_at.description: When the server read it: the tiles' figures are read then, from the books as they stand (the KPI's own ledger revision says which).

role.description: The role whose layout it is, when source is role.

source.description: user: arranged by the caller; role: arranged for their role; default: the workbook's headline KPIs.

tiles.description: The tiles, as placed. A tile shows only what the viewer's own rights read: if the caller may not read the KPIs the list is empty.

version.description: The caller's own layout's version, 0 when they have none: it is the ETag of saveMyDashboard.
